study type: Interrupted time series analysis and cross-sectional study
exposure: Diagnostic classification systems (WHO disease chapters, HHS-HCCs, AHRQ-CCS)
cohort: Over 18 million people aged 0 to 64 years with private insurance
finding: The study found that the transition to ICD-10-CM was associated with large prevalence changes for many diagnostic categories, particularly in the HHS-HCC and AHRQ-CCS systems.
mod_finding: The rate for completed pregnancy with complications decreased by 54.5% partly due to removing vaginal birth after cesarean delivery as a complication.
